next.chatgpt.card.foot: Your own ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan, for a plain chat without an agent. The sign-in is personal: don't share it with other people. Its usage counts toward your ChatGPT limits — see them in ChatGPT's settings.
next.chatgpt.emptyNote: A plain chat on your ChatGPT plan: no agent, no files of this machine.
next.chatgpt.err.accountMismatch: This is a different ChatGPT account. Sign in with the one you chose.
next.chatgpt.err.badCallback: That's not the address of the sign-in's end. Copy the whole address from the browser bar.
next.chatgpt.err.busy: An answer is still coming. Wait or stop it.
next.chatgpt.err.denied: The sign-in was cancelled in ChatGPT.
next.chatgpt.err.incomplete: The answer stopped before the end. Try again.
next.chatgpt.err.network: ChatGPT didn't answer. Check the connection and try again.
next.chatgpt.err.noPlan: ChatGPT didn't allow using your plan here. Sign in again and allow it.
next.chatgpt.err.notEligible: This ChatGPT plan can't be used in other apps.

next.chatgpt.err.state: This sign-in is out of date. Start it again.

next.chatgpt.voice.about: About you and how to answer you
next.chatgpt.voice.aboutHint: The voice knows this from the first words of every call. It goes only into your calls; the journal keeps only its length.
next.chatgpt.voice.aboutPlaceholder: For example: call me by name, answer briefly and to the point, no polite openers
next.chatgpt.voice.bargeHint: Start speaking and the voice stops to listen.
next.chatgpt.voice.digest.hint: The agent tells the digest out loud — interrupt and ask any time
next.chatgpt.voice.newChat: Voice mode in a new chat
next.chatgpt.voice.byKey: The voice goes through the Realtime API with the OpenAI key from Settings → Voice input, paid by the key.
next.chatgpt.voice.deliveryNarrateSub: “Opened the board”, “changing colors” — no long silence
next.chatgpt.voice.deliveryResultSub: Quiet until the result. By voice: “be quiet” / “tell me as you go”
next.chatgpt.voice.effort.instantSub: First sound at once; simple things it answers itself, the rest goes to the agent
next.chatgpt.voice.effort.lowSub: Almost at once; anything that needs thought goes to the agent
next.chatgpt.voice.effort.mediumSub: Weighs its answer; anything that needs thought goes to the agent
next.chatgpt.voice.effortHint: What a call starts with. By voice: “think harder” / “faster”
next.chatgpt.voice.fail.noLogin: Sign in with ChatGPT to talk by voice.
next.chatgpt.voice.fail.noRoute: OpenAI's voice server gave no address for the sound — try calling again.
next.chatgpt.voice.fail.off: Voice mode is off. Turn it on in Settings → Accounts → ChatGPT, or add an OpenAI key in Settings → Voice input.
next.chatgpt.voice.fail.silent: No sound: this device could not reach OpenAI's voice server — the network, a VPN or a firewall blocks WebRTC (UDP).
next.chatgpt.voice.floatHint: Speak — I’ll do it in your last chat
next.chatgpt.voice.head: Character
next.chatgpt.voice.headHint: The assistant's head in the field while you talk
next.chatgpt.voice.noLogin: Sign in with ChatGPT to talk by voice
next.chatgpt.voice.notHeard: I did not catch that, please say it again.
next.chatgpt.voice.notes: Remember my agents' notes about me
next.chatgpt.voice.notesHint: Short lines from the project agents' memory — about you and how you ask to work
next.chatgpt.voice.oneModel: On the ChatGPT subscription the voice answers with one model: the route takes no other. With an OpenAI key there is a choice.
next.chatgpt.voice.risk: Goes through ChatGPT's voice route for Codex, which OpenAI does not allow other apps to use: access may be cut off or the account limited. Turn it on at your own risk.
next.chatgpt.voice.switch: Voice mode on the subscription (unofficial route)

next.chatgpt.voice.talkTextSub: What is said and the answer show on the field's line
next.chatgpt.voice.talkVoiceSub: Nothing is written in the field, only the wave
next.chatgpt.voice.wakeHint: The voice starts without a button. The page itself listens for the phrase; no sound leaves it until the phrase is said. A speech model of about 46 MB is downloaded once.
next.chatgpt.voice.wakeMic: No microphone access: the phrase can't be heard
next.chatgpt.voice.wakeModel: Couldn't load the model for the phrase
